# Portable React UI source

Engineering documentation generated by Codex; not site copy or a Jah quotation.

This package contains the existing Base UI/shadcn primitives, blocks, sections, layouts, browser preference providers and theme tokens, plus optional user-supplied branding exposed separately as design-presets. It contains no site routes, editorial quotations, pictures, Clerk/Neon configuration, database migrations or private archives. Imports are relative, so consuming projects need no OnlyJah path alias. This is source distribution for a TypeScript-aware React build, not precompiled JavaScript or an Astro-native component library.

In a TanStack/Vite React application, copy `src/components`, `src/lib`, `src/styles.css` and `src/theme.css` into your own source tree, or install this folder as a local dependency. Import `@onlyjah/ui/styles.css` once. Add the package source to Tailwind's scan with `@source "../node_modules/@onlyjah/ui/src";` in your app CSS, adjusting the relative path to that CSS file. Use the package's declared dependency versions. ThemeToggle requires ThemeProvider; interactive components require React hydration. The source accessibility adjustments are recorded in the main repository's `docs/FRONTEND.md`.

```tsx
import { Card, CardContent } from '@onlyjah/ui/ui/card'
import { PageHeader } from '@onlyjah/ui/blocks/page-header'
```

For a static Astro application, enable `@astrojs/react` and `@tailwindcss/vite` in an `output: 'static'` project. Install compatible stable Astro integration versions after checking their React/Vite peer ranges. Use these React components in `.astro` pages; hydrate interactive controls with `client:load`. A single React island should own a provider and its consumer controls. Astro pages outside that island cannot share the React context. Keep a site-specific route and content layer in the consuming application.

Identity/data features are a separate integration. Use the same Clerk application with verified satellite-domain settings and the same authorized Neon Data API to share account identity and permitted records. Never copy `.env.local`, provider secrets or database credentials into a client template. Backend payment and upload operations remain in a separate trusted service. UI portability does not itself verify SSO or payment flows.

For design selection, wrap one React tree in ThemeProvider, then DesignProvider with a stable presets array. DesignSelector consumes that context. The optional preset data imports from `@onlyjah/ui/design-presets`; its Claude-reference provenance is included. Supply `designInitScript(presets, storageKey)` alongside the theme initialization before styles paint when the consuming app needs persistent design without a first-paint flash. Both scripts need CSP hashes/nonces on strict hosts. The source manifest records its Git base revision and dirty state plus hashes of the actual exported files.

Verified on 3 October 2026: an independent Astro 7.3.5 / @astrojs/react 7.0.0 / React 19.3 / Tailwind 4.3.3 app built static HTML, CSS and the React appearance island from a file-installed export. Its installed package typecheck passed after resolving the pnpm package directory before invoking tsc. This is build/type compatibility evidence, not browser interaction or SSO evidence. [Astro React integration](https://docs.astro.build/en/guides/integrations-guide/react/).
